result.title: To Defer or Not to Defer? Online Learning with LLMs and Congested Experts
result.summary: Modern AI systems increasingly combine large language models (LLMs) with human experts, using the LLM to handle routine queries while deferring uncertain cases for expert review. When expert capacity is limited, however, deferral decisions must account not only for the reliability of the LLM but also for congestion in the expert queue. We formulate this as an online sequential decision-making problem in which, for each query, the system observes the confidence signal of the LLM's answer and must decide whether to output the answer or defer the query to a capacity-constrained expert. The reliability of the confidence signal is initially unknown and must be learned from expert feedback, which is both selectively observed (only deferred queries are labeled) and delayed by queuing. We propose \texttt{KL-PBD}, a learning algorithm that uses Kullback--Leibler lower confidence bounds on the unknown reliability parameters to guide deferral decisions. For $K$ confidence levels and horizon $T$, \texttt{KL-PBD} achieves $O(K\log T)$ gap-dependent regret when the accuracy at every confidence level is bounded away from the deferral boundary, and $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{KT})$ worst-case regret. We establish matching lower bounds, showing that these rates are optimal up to logarithmic factors. Finally, we validate our approach on synthetic instances and real-world question-answering datasets, namely GSM8K, NuminaMath, and MedMCQA, using Qwen LLMs.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把「直接输出 LLM 答案还是转交给容量受限的人类专家」建模为在线序贯决策问题：置信信号的可靠性未知、且反馈只对已延迟样本可见并受排队延迟影响，作者提出基于 KL 下置信界的 KL-PBD 算法，给出 gap-dependent 与最坏情形的 regret 上下界，并在 GSM8K、NuminaMath、MedMCQA 上用 Qwen 验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「置信度—转交/停止」决策与 LVR 中 STOP 时机、不确定性估计和计算成本权衡问题表述相近，且「反馈仅对延迟样本可见且有延迟」的设置可能为 latent 推理中的部分可观测监督与贡献分配提供可核查的线索。
